events.title: A major earthquake strikes Arabia and the Levant
events.description: The first of two major Near Eastern earthquakes that year had its epicentre in the northwestern Arabian Peninsula, around Tabuk. The second, on 29 May, was most damaging in Ramla in Palestine; contemporary sources often merge the two.
events.html: The first of two major Near Eastern earthquakes that year had its epicentre in the northwestern Arabian Peninsula, around Tabuk. The second, on 29 May, was most damaging in Ramla in Palestine; contemporary sources often merge the two.

events.title: Frederick II crowns himself King of Jerusalem
events.description: Having regained Jerusalem by treaty while excommunicated, the Emperor took the crown from the altar of the Holy Sepulchre and placed it on his own head. No cleric would crown him.
events.html: Having regained Jerusalem by treaty while excommunicated, the Emperor took the crown from the altar of the Holy Sepulchre and placed it on his own head. No cleric would crown him.

events.title: Mongols defeat the Polish armies at the Battle of Chmielnik
events.description: During the first Mongol invasion of Poland, Mongol forces defeated the Polish armies of Sandomierz and Kraków near Chmielnik, between Kraków and Kielce. The invasion culminated in the Mongol victory at Legnica in April.
events.html: During the first Mongol invasion of Poland, Mongol forces defeated the Polish armies of Sandomierz and Kraków near Chmielnik, between Kraków and Kielce. The invasion culminated in the Mongol victory at Legnica in April.

events.title: Street fighting erupts in Berlin
events.description: Troops fired on a crowd outside the royal palace and barricade fighting spread through the city, leaving hundreds dead. King Frederick William IV withdrew the army and promised a constitution.
events.html: Troops fired on a crowd outside the royal palace and barricade fighting spread through the city, leaving hundreds dead. King Frederick William IV withdrew the army and promised a constitution.

events.title: Parisians rise up and begin the Paris Commune
events.description: Attempts by the government to remove the National Guard's cannon from Montmartre provoked an uprising. The Commune ruled Paris until it was crushed in the 'Bloody Week' of May.
events.html: Attempts by the government to remove the National Guard's cannon from Montmartre provoked an uprising. The Commune ruled Paris until it was crushed in the 'Bloody Week' of May.

events.title: Alexei Leonov makes the first spacewalk
events.description: The Soviet cosmonaut spent about 12 minutes outside Voskhod 2. His suit ballooned in the vacuum, and he had to let out air to squeeze back into the airlock.
events.html: The Soviet cosmonaut spent about 12 minutes outside Voskhod 2. His suit ballooned in the vacuum, and he had to let out air to squeeze back into the airlock.

events.title: East Germany holds its first free elections
events.description: East Germans voted in their first free parliamentary elections. The conservative Alliance for Germany won, opening the way to rapid reunification with West Germany in October.
events.html: East Germans voted in their first free parliamentary elections. The conservative Alliance for Germany won, opening the way to rapid reunification with West Germany in October.

events.title: Russia signs a treaty annexing Crimea
events.description: Two days after a referendum held under Russian military control, Vladimir Putin signed a treaty absorbing Crimea. Most UN members regard the annexation as illegal.
events.html: Two days after a referendum held under Russian military control, Vladimir Putin signed a treaty absorbing Crimea. Most UN members regard the annexation as illegal.
